_comment: The quota tier table below is for `local` ONLY. On a deployed host infra emits it as
infra/main.bicep `quotaTiers` parameter that creates the APIM products (#201), so there is
exactly one source and a fork that overrides that parameter cannot drift. Locally there is no
gateway to emit anything and GatewayOptions.Tiers is required, so the values live here,
mirroring the bicep defaults (GatewayOptionsTiersTests pins the two together).
